description: A distinct question that customers asked the AI Receptionist, with every time it was asked in the report period. Returned in the `questions` list of `GET /v3/online_presence/ai_receptionist_questions`. Date-time fields use ISO 8601 format.

question.description: The question in the business's language, generalized the way any customer would ask it.

count.description: How many times it was asked in the period (a customer asking twice in one conversation counts twice).

avg_certainty.description: Mean of the receptionist's 1–5 confidence on its replies to this question; `null` when none carried one.

conversions.description: How many of `count` asks came from a conversation that ended linked to a CRM contact: a captured lead or a returning customer. Counted per ask, like `count`.

occurrences.description: The asks in the period, newest first, at most 50; `count` is still exact.

items.description: One time the question was asked in the period.

conversation_uid.description: The conversation the question was asked in (see `ai_receptionist_conversations`).

text.description: The customer's wording, generalized (no names, contact details, dates or times); falls back to the question in the business language.

certainty.description: The receptionist's own 1–5 confidence in its reply to this ask, when it recorded one.

message_index.description: Zero-based index of the visitor message in the conversation's transcript `messages`.

answered.description: At least one learning linked to this question has been applied to the receptionist's knowledge.

example.question: When is Handyman for a Day available?

occurrences.text: What days are open for Handyman for a Day?
